title: The car race
description: A bilingual lesson in which the narrator and his wife describe a very big car race near their town in 1995: hundreds of people, twenty cars from six countries, an exciting finish, and the winner Billy Stewart in car number fifteen — followed by the wife's comment on the way home, 'Don't drive so quickly! You're not Billy Stewart!'. Includes a complete-the-text gap fill, answering questions on the text, a there was/were gap fill, and grammar on in/on/at time prepositions, completing dialogues with was/were, and were-questions with cues. 课文讲述作者和妻子1995年在镇附近观看的一场盛大的汽车比赛：数百名观众、来自六个国家的二十辆赛车、激动人心的冲刺，获胜者是15号车里的比利·斯图尔特——回家路上妻子对他说：“别开得这么快！你可不是比利·斯图尔特啊！”配合课文填空、课文问答、there was/were 填空，以及 in/on/at 时间介词、was/were 完成对话和带提示的 were 问句语法练习。
answer_note: Workbook A (complete text) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 69 key (img/key-067-072.jpg). Workbook B (answering questions) item 1 is a printed example; the remaining answers follow the printed example pattern and the text and are labelled suggested. Workbook C answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 69 key (img/key-067-072.jpg). Grammar I and III answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 69 grammar key (PDF viewer page 500); grammar II items 1-2 are printed examples, and the remaining answers follow the printed example pattern and the given cues and are labelled suggested. No external sources were used. Grammar source audit: see reports/grammar-source-audit.json; source section order, complete prompts and answers restored.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question.
Which car was the winner in 1995?
听录音，然后回答问题。哪辆车在 1995 年的比赛中获胜？
lesson.translation: Listen then answer this question. Which car was the winner in 1995?

lesson.text:
There is a car race near our town every year.
In 1995, there was a very big race.
lesson.translation: 在我们镇子附近每年都有一场汽车比赛。1995年举行了一次盛大的比赛。

lesson.text:
There were hundreds of people there.
My wife and I were at the race.
Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.
You can see us in the crowd.
We are standing on the left.
lesson.translation: 许许多多的人都去了赛场。我和我的妻子也去了。我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也去了。你可以在人群中看到我们。我们站在左面。

lesson.text:
There were twenty cars in the race.
There were English cars, French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars.
lesson.translation: 有20辆汽车参加比赛。有英国、法国、德国、意大利、美国和日本的汽车。

lesson.text:
It was an exciting finish.
The winner was Billy Stewart.
He was in car number fifteen.
Five other cars were just behind him.
lesson.translation: 比赛的结尾是激动人心的。获胜者是比利·斯图尔特。他在第15号车里，其他5辆汽车紧跟在他后面。

lesson.text:
On the way home, my wife said to me,
'Don't drive so quickly! You're not Billy Stewart!'
lesson.translation: 在回家的途中，我妻子对我说：“别开得这么快！你可不是比利·斯图尔特啊！”

items.title: hundreds of ...
items.text: 数以百计的……，用来表示不确定数量的复数形式。

items.title: On the way home
items.text: 在回家的途中。on the way 是指“在路上”。

lesson.text:
参考译文
在我们镇子附近每年都有一场汽车比赛。1995年举行了一次盛大的比赛。

许许多多的人都去了赛场。我和我的妻子也去了。我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也去了。你可以在人群中看到我们。我们站在左面。

有20辆汽车参加比赛。有英国、法国、德国、意大利、美国和日本的汽车。

比赛的结尾是激动人心的。获胜者是比利·斯图尔特。他在第15号车里，其他5辆汽车紧跟在他后面。

在回家的途中，我妻子对我说：“别开得这么快！你可不是比利·斯图尔特啊！”
lesson.translation: Full Chinese reference translation of the lesson text.

questions.prompt:
Were you and your friends in the country last weekend? (yes)
When were you there? (from ten in the morning to four in the afternoon)
questions.answer:
Yes, we were.
We were there from ten in the morning to four in the afternoon.

audio_segments.text: Were you and your friends in the country last weekend?

questions.prompt:
Were Tom and Mary absent from school last Friday? (yes)
Where were they? (home)

Yes, they were.
They were at home.

questions.prompt:
Were you and your wife at the car race on May 16th? (no)

questions.prompt:
Were you in Turkey in 2000? (no)
Where were you? (Japan)
questions.answer:
No, I wasn't. (or: No, we weren't.)
I was (or: We were) in Japan.

questions.prompt:

When were you there? (about five)
questions.answer:
Yes, I was. / Yes, we were.
I was there at about five. / We were there at about five.

audio_segments.text: Were you at the baker's on Tuesday afternoon?
